Engine & licenses

Chess Lens uses Stockfish.js 17.1 lite single-thread, distributed under GPLv3. Engine scores and labels are approximate at the selected search budget.

Stockfish GPLv3 license · Corresponding engine source and build instructions

Legal moves and PGN parsing use chess.js 1.4.0. BSD-2-Clause license · Source

Classic chess pieces by Colin M. L. Burnett, GPL version 2 or later. Piece license · Original SVG source. The unmodified SVG source is also served in assets/pieces/.

This app is independent of Chess.com and Lichess. It does not reproduce their accuracy metrics or classifications.
